title: さんぽ (Sanpo — A Walk)
description: The opening theme of Studio Ghibli's 1988 film となりのトトロ (My Neighbor Totoro), sung by 井上あずみ (Inoue Azumi) with the Suginami Children's Choir. Lyrics by 中川李枝子 (Nakagawa Rieko), music by 久石譲 (Joe Hisaishi). The song describes a cheerful walk through the countryside — up hills, through tunnels, across grasslands and bumpy gravel roads, past bees, lizards, snakes, and grasshoppers — ending with an invitation to foxes and raccoons to join the adventure. Ideal for absolute beginners: entirely hiragana-friendly vocabulary, upbeat melody, and themes of outdoor play. Nearly every vocabulary item is N5 level. Key words: あるく (to walk), 元気 (energetic), 坂道 (slope), トンネル (tunnel), ともだち (friend), たんけん (exploration).
